findings.body:
Gain 5, Work 2, Harm 3
Raise: Not done - A push whose new commits change only Forge's record files never cancels or restarts a running or queued test run of the same code: close holds its record commits until the checks report (or pushes them with the code), and a record-only push reuses the earlier result; new and existing repos get it on upgrade and forge sync.
Case: normal use - GitHub has queued a workflow but has not published a job check yet. `_let_finish` discards the missing-check result from `_pending` and returns when its observed states contain no pending job (`src/forge/checks.py:180-183`), so this call pushes the records and cancels the queued run. The repository already models a queued run without a check at `tests/test_close_reruns_cancelled_ci.py:48`; the new push test supplies an already-running check instead. Two other paths bypass the same protection: a net-empty sequence of record commits returns at `checks.py:209`, and an owner-choice push rejected after another machine updates the branch reconciles and pushes again at `src/forge/close.py:880-881` without checking the new remote head.
findings.title: Not done: Wait for the actual queued run before publishing records

findings.body:
Gain 4, Work 2, Harm 3
Raise: Not done - A push whose new commits change only Forge's record files never cancels or restarts a running or queued test run of the same code: close holds its record commits until the checks report (or pushes them with the code), and a record-only push reuses the earlier result; new and existing repos get it on upgrade and forge sync.
Case: normal use - a replacement worker starts a new conversation, makes no code change, and close publishes its records. `src/forge/codex.py:246-251` commits the `chat` field, but it is absent from this bookkeeping set, so the ancestor walk rejects that commit and runs the suite again. The same classifier rejects other Forge records, including `plans/spotted.json` and story-plan records, and rejects record-only merge commits at `src/forge/templates/review-tests.py:111-125`. The new failed-result test populates the listed fields but not these record forms.

findings.body:
Gain 4, Work 2, Harm 3
Raise: Functional
Case: normal use - close is interrupted during its wait, publishes its saved records as the coordinator allowed, and the resulting push cancels the unfinished parent workflow. Once GitHub reports that parent as `cancelled`, this line treats it as a completed test failure, so the new workflow fails its gate without testing the code. A real failed parent has a related recovery problem: rerunning the failed jobs on the record-only head reads the same parent failure and exits again, defeating the existing retry contract at `src/forge/checks.py:485-541` and `src/forge/land.py:232-270`.
Adds work: run tests when the parent has no completed result or a retry is requested; F 3 x H 2 = 6; 2 x C = 4.
findings.title: Allow cancelled and retried record-only runs to execute tests

findings.body:
Gain 4, Work 2, Harm 3
Raise: Functional
Case: normal use - a review finishes with findings while the code's CI reports a failure. `_pending` raises the red-check refusal, and this `finally` pushes the records but lets the exception escape. Close therefore never reaches its PR update or prints the findings at `src/forge/close.py:444-452`. The same escape from a stuck-record push bypasses the shared PR update and owner question at `close.py:620-622,641-644`. The ruling permits a failure to end the wait; it does not publish the review or question that the caller skipped.
findings.title: Publish the review and owner question after a red check ends the wait

findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 2, Harm 3
Raise: Not done - A push whose new commits change only Forge's record files never cancels or restarts a running or queued test run of the same code: close holds its record commits until the checks report (or pushes them with the code), and a record-only push reuses the earlier result; new and existing repos get it on upgrade and forge sync.
Case: normal use - a close with unpushed code has failing local tests and its reviewer refuses. `src/forge/close.py:388-392` saves the failed-test record, but this guard refuses to publish it because the outgoing commits also contain code, leaving the record only on that machine. An early non-exception exit also bypasses the context manager: the binary-fixture refusal returns 1 at `close.py:277-284` after the record save at `close.py:264`. Both miss the coordinator's explicit exit-flush contract.

findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 1, Harm 3
Raise: Gate
Case: normal use - a coordinator adds the shipped records-only action to a client workflow. The changed action now exits nonzero when the parent failed, so the client's build does not run. The shipped coordinator guidance still says a failed parent produces `false` and the workflow runs normally (`src/forge/templates/skill.md:2496-2498`); the updated worker brief describes the push wait but does not correct this action behavior. Upgrade and sync therefore deliver instructions that describe the opposite result.
findings.title: Gate: Update the shipped instructions for failed parent runs

why: Issue 1723: during forge close, Forge's own record commits (review result, owner choice, stuck/fixing) are pushed while the pull request's test groups are queued or running; the generated workflow cancels in-progress pull_request runs, so each record push throws away the running tests and all groups restart on unchanged code (one client night: 25 of 44 runs cancelled, 50 of 55 cancels caused by record pushes)
